solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Group is backing places

indicators.note: backing means moving in the opposite direction, so the joined words are read from right to left

blocks.note: a set is a group of things that belong together
taken as written

explanation.surface: A band or team is going backwards to various venues.
explanation.definitionFit: Sites are locations, synonyms for places where something stands or happens.

clue.text: South American greeting Japanese food

blocks.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south
US stands for the United States, so American
hi is an informal greeting

explanation.surface: A South American hello somehow attached to a Japanese dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'South American' reads as one continent, but it splits into two separate abbreviations.
explanation.definitionFit: Sushi is the Japanese dish of vinegared rice with raw fish or other toppings.

clue.text: Various patterns in part of church

indicators.note: various suggests many different forms, so the letters are set out in another order

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Assorted designs found in a section of a church, such as stained glass or floor tiles.
explanation.definitionFit: A transept is either arm crossing the nave of a cross-shaped church building.

clue.text: Sign of pollution around river provides tension

indicators.note: around means placed on every side, so one piece wraps the other

blocks.note: a stain is a mark left by contamination
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Evidence of contamination near a river causes stress for the locals.
explanation.definitionFit: Strain is the state of being stretched or under pressure, a synonym of tension.

clue.text: Get back group of soldiers with masterstroke

blocks.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a coup is a brilliantly successful move

explanation.surface: Retrieve a squad of troops by a clever piece of strategy.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoup is to regain or recover something lost, such as money spent.

clue.text: Fog is surrounding mount? On the contrary

indicators.note: surrounding means enclosing on all sides, so one piece goes around another
on the contrary flips the stated relation, so the outer and inner roles are swapped

blocks.note: Mt is the abbreviation for mount, as in a mountain name
taken as written

explanation.surface: Fog wrapping round a mountain is a familiar sight, or is it the other way?
explanation.walkthrough: Read straight, 'is' goes round the mountain; 'On the contrary' reverses that, so the mountain abbreviation goes round 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Mist is a thin fog of fine water droplets hanging in the air.

clue.text: Cover electric vehicle crossing North Pole after overturning

indicators.note: crossing means going across and so straddling, so one piece sits inside the other
overturning means turning upside down, which in a down clue reads the word in the opposite direction

blocks.note: EV is the standard abbreviation for electric vehicle
N is the compass abbreviation for north
taken as written

explanation.surface: An electric car making an Arctic trip to the North Pole and flipping over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'North Pole' looks like one place, but North is a single letter and Pole stands alone, turned round after it.
explanation.definitionFit: To envelop is to wrap or surround something completely, so to cover it.

clue.text: Actor's remarkable at reading

indicators.note: remarkable implies something out of the ordinary, so the letters are arranged unusually

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A performer is exceptionally good at a script read-through.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe-s is 'is', joining the definition to the wordplay rather than showing possession.
explanation.definitionFit: A tragedian is an actor who specialises in tragic roles, so a kind of actor.

clue.text: Each April, at sea, leave for islands

indicators.note: at sea means confused and all over the place, so the letters are jumbled

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged
to go is to leave

explanation.surface: Every spring, sailors set off from port bound for an island chain.
explanation.definitionFit: An archipelago is a group or chain of islands scattered across an area of sea.

clue.text: Activity around a component of flight

indicators.note: around means on every side, so one piece is wrapped about the other

blocks.note: a stir is a bustle of activity
taken as written

explanation.surface: Bustle surrounding part of an aeroplane journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight' suggests air travel, but here it is a flight of stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight is a series of steps between floors, so a single stair is one element of it.

clue.text: Hard work interrupted by openings for trilling light laugh

indicators.note: interrupted means broken into, so other letters are put inside the word
openings are the beginnings of words, so only their first letters are used

blocks.note: a chore is a tiresome task
the first letters of these two words

explanation.surface: A tough job interrupted by birdsong breaking out, giving a light chuckle.
explanation.walkthrough: The two first letters slot in just before the final letter of the task word.
explanation.definitionFit: To chortle is to laugh in a gleeful, chuckling way; here the noun sense, a gleeful chuckle.

clue.text: One additional thought: question dumping a husband in Suffolk town

indicators.note: dumping means throwing away, so something is removed from the word

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
PS, postscript, is a thought added at the end of a letter
which is a question word
H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: Someone in a Suffolk town has a further thought: should a spouse be ditched?
explanation.walkthrough: Only one of the two Hs in the question word is dropped, the first. Suffolk is an English county on the east coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Ipswich is the county town of Suffolk, in eastern England, so a town of that county.

clue.text: I've reached P for "painting technique"

blocks.note: having reached a point, I am past what came before it, so I'M PAST
the letter just before P in the alphabet, the one already left behind

explanation.surface: A speaker announcing they have got to the letter P in some list, which stands for a painting term.
explanation.walkthrough: If you have reached P, you are past O, the letter before it; read as one phrase that is I'M PAST O.
explanation.definitionFit: Impasto is the technique of laying paint on thickly so that brush or knife marks stand out.

clue.text: Small cage holding rodents up, for example

indicators.note: up in a down clue means read from bottom to top, so the word runs backwards
holding means keeping inside, so one piece contains the other

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a pen is an enclosure for animals
mice are small rodents

explanation.surface: A little enclosure keeping rodents upright, say, as in a pet shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A specimen is a sample or single instance taken as typical, so an example.

clue.text: DIY works in part a source of great value

indicators.note: works means is worked on or processed, so the letters are reshaped
in means placed inside, so the shuffled letters sit within the other word

blocks.note: the three letters rearranged
taken as written

explanation.surface: Home improvement jobs are partly a valuable resource.
explanation.walkthrough: DIY, do-it-yourself, is home repair done by the owner.
explanation.definitionFit: Pay dirt is ground rich enough in ore to be worth mining, hence any source of profit or reward.

clue.text: Opponent quite ignoring it regarding historic thing

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out of consideration, so some letters are dropped

blocks.note: an anti is someone opposed to something
taken as written
the letters to be removed

explanation.surface: An opponent pretty much dismisses an old relic.
explanation.definitionFit: An antique is an old object valued for its age, such as furniture from a past era.

clue.text: Source always of quite unusual and strongly augmented radiation?

definitions.text: Source always of quite unusual and strongly augmented radiation?

indicators.note: a source is where something begins, and always means every time, so each word gives its opening letter

blocks.clueFragment: quite unusual and strongly augmented radiation
blocks.note: the first letter of each of these six words

explanation.surface: A question about what emits a strangely powerful burst of radiation.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay: the opening letters spell the answer, and the clue describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: A quasar is a distant, extremely luminous galactic nucleus pouring out intense radiation.

clue.text: Less common to pursue fine food

blocks.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
odder means more unusual, so less common

explanation.surface: Something rarer chasing a fine dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to pursue' puts the comparative after the abbreviation, since in a down clue pursuing means coming below.
explanation.definitionFit: Fodder is food for livestock such as hay or straw, and loosely any food.

clue.text: Zoo resident offering the smallest bit of pride?

blocks.note: first meaning: a young big cat living in a zoo
second meaning: a pride is a group of lions, and its littlest member is its youngest

explanation.walkthrough: 'Pride' reads as the feeling of self-respect, but a pride is also a group of lions.
explanation.definitionFit: A lion cub is a baby lion, both a zoo animal and the youngest, tiniest member of a lion pride.

clue.text: Judge supports embargo on old instrument

blocks.note: an embargo is an official ban
J is the abbreviation for judge
O is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: A judge backs a ban on an outdated musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'supports' puts the judge letter beneath the embargo word.
explanation.definitionFit: A banjo is a stringed musical instrument with a round drum-like body.

clue.text: Picture AM radio broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered widely, as seed is sown, so the letters are scattered

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Imagine a show transmitted on AM radio.
explanation.definitionFit: A diorama is a three-dimensional scene or model, a kind of picture shown in depth.

clue.text: Wild party showing limitations to order generally

indicators.note: limitations are boundaries, so only the outer letters of each word are taken

blocks.note: the first and last letters
the first and last letters

explanation.surface: A rowdy party displaying how law and order are generally limited.
explanation.definitionFit: An orgy is a wild, unrestrained party of excessive indulgence.

clue.text: Malevolent spirit in protest ending in disruption

indicators.note: ending means the final part of something, so only the last letter of the word is used

blocks.note: a demo is a protest march
the last letter

explanation.surface: An evil force lurking within a demonstration that ends in chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon is an evil supernatural being, a wicked spirit in religion and folklore.

clue.text: Equipment given to spy involving a right palaver

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the spy word holds the other letters inside

blocks.note: a rig is a set of equipment
a mole is a spy planted inside an organisation
taken as written
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Handing gear to an undercover agent turns into a real fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right palaver' looks like an emphatic British phrase meaning a real fuss, but right is a single letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A rigmarole is a long, tedious, complicated procedure, which a palaver also means in British usage.

clue.text: Extract from commentator on doubtful piece of music

indicators.note: an extract is a part taken out of a longer text, so the letters run inside the words

blocks.note: the letters run across the word boundaries

explanation.surface: A passage taken from a pundit discussing a dubious musical work.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondo is a musical form in which a main theme returns between contrasting sections.
